difficulty_audit.finding: The scenario is structurally hard under replay-derived admission but not discriminative for GLM-5.2.
difficulty_audit.observed_shortcut: The model issued seven to nine broad read calls in its first turn. list_action_runs plus get_deployment_state exposed the decisive workflow and deployment state, after which each variant reduced to a short dispatch, start-runner, redispatch, or preserve decision followed by the same completion tail.
difficulty_audit.implication: Evidence-group count and fixed-policy failure are insufficient proxies for strong-model difficulty when parallel reads can collapse the state reconstruction problem into one model turn.
difficulty_audit.required_next_change: A harder successor must distribute decisive facts across narrower native records, include multiple plausible related runs and deployments, and require recovery of partially completed downstream effects that cannot be delegated to one idempotent workflow rerun. The frozen public-development result must not be retroactively changed.
